text.tspan: swapping weights in and out by hand is easy to get wrong: forget the second
half, and training silently continues on the averaged weights
:" restores the trained weights on the way out, always
contextmanager turns a function with one "yield" into something a with-block can use: the code before the yield runs
on entering, the code after it on leaving — even if the block fails halfway.

svg.text: THE RESULT — where the weights are while the model is checked
